goal: Make existing tattoo art understandable through one consolidated placement guide, while preserving clean art and scoped default/optional/history distinctions.
suppliedMaterial: Eight existing images: three requested guide sources, two current face/cheek references, one optional composite and two mixed contact sheets.
intendedChange: Annotation, source indexing and removal of unrelated material from a derivative contact sheet. No character redesign or new tattoo invention.
preserve: Source originals, pixel resolution and provenance
Exact lowercase eye/know spelling and observed distinction between cursive eye and serif know
Gold-standard cheek placement and current default no-dice face
Exact gold N and flourish in supplied Scoundrel artwork
Optional dice and historical/unplaced motifs kept out of default guide head
Character-side and viewer-side labels; never infer anatomy from a cropped forearm

legend.name: eye
legend.lettering: Lowercase cursive eye. Match the visible cheek source, not a generic replacement font.
legend.guideAction: Place one numbered pointer on character-right cheek; preserve size/angle relative to source as a visual guide, without claiming calibrated millimetres.

legend.name: know
legend.lettering: Lowercase serif/upright know in lf_cheeks; the cursive know on both flat sheets differs.
legend.guideAction: Point to character-left cheek and show the exact source crop or label. Mark the supplied cursive flat candidate as mismatch; do not silently approve or substitute it.
unknowns: Correct matching standalone know art not verified
legend.conflict: Flat cursive know conflicts with user gold-standard serif lettering.

legend.name: Scoundrel
legend.lettering: Black Gothic lettering, gold N, underline flourish in standalone source. Forearm context shows simpler black lettering without all standalone details.
legend.guideAction: Use one small neutral forearm inset, label side unverified. Preserve exact standalone art in its own legend tile; do not place it on the head or mirror lettering.
unknowns: Exact transfer relationship between ornate flat art and simpler photographed word

legend.name: Dice
legend.region: forehead above character-left brow in optional composite
legend.guideAction: Keep in optional legend rail with a small positional callout only. Main default neutral head has no dice. Do not treat a generic pair of dice as an exact transfer of this face variant.

legend.name: Chewie lettering
legend.guideAction: List as historical/Multiverse with placement unverified. Do not invent a forehead location or add to default head.
unknowns: Applicable body placement/source version for this exact artwork

legend.name: Bird
legend.region: face/neck previously proposed; exact location unresolved
legend.guideAction: Keep as optional/unplaced legend tile. Do not map onto default face or revive an old placement.
unknowns: Matching on-body source for this drawing

necessaryRegionInsets.reason: Scoundrel is not a head tattoo; anatomical side remains unverified.

cleanSheetDerivatives.task: One stencil-art-only derivative. Remove character photos, wolf scene, masks, photo cutouts and unrelated visual material. A body-placement sketch is not a flat stencil: retain only separable standalone motif artwork with verified source; otherwise omit and list as needs original. Keep Hon and Lisan source/lane labels distinct. Do not transfer Lisan worm designs into Hon.

One indexed derivative of the existing 25-cell contact sheet. Keep original order and artwork; replace giant/hash filenames with short labels F0-01 through F0-25 in original row-major order. Return a mapping from each label to original asset ID/full filename/hash, project, motif and source status. Do not redraw any artwork or infer missing mappings.

outputLimits.stopAfter: Return these bounded proofs and manifest; await review before extra views, stencil reconstructions, variant development or batch expansion.

layout.main: Neutral unadorned front-facing head/upper-neck diagram; only verified current cheek pointers on default view. Not a new identity model.
layout.separateRail: Legend tiles showing source artwork ID, status and permitted placement; unknown entries remain unplaced.
layout.forearmInset: One neutral forearm schematic with region-only pointer and explicit anatomical side unverified.
layout.text: Short motif names and legend codes; full filenames/IDs in companion manifest. No arrows or labels burned into clean art.
layout.sideConvention: Character-right is viewer-left in frontal guide; character-left is viewer-right. State view explicitly for every inset.

knownConflicts.finding: Flat know is cursive, gold-standard on-body know is serif/upright. Placement guide must use on-body authority and mark flat art mismatch.
Standalone ornate art has gold N/flourish; forearm photo is simpler black lettering. Region is established, exact transfer and arm side are not.
These are mixed project/variant source collections. Indexing or keeping a sheet does not approve every motif or place it all on Hon.

acceptanceChecks: Every legend entry maps to a real supplied source ID and actual filename/hash
No eye/know swaps; know is not silently redrawn cursive
Default head has no optional dice, bird or Chewie text
Scoundrel appears in forearm inset with side unverified, not on face
Clean-art images contain no placement arrows/labels; annotated guide is separate
All omitted mixed-sheet items and unresolved placements are listed honestly
Actual returned files are independently reviewed before acceptance; requested review scopes stay requested
